title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-29
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate (1-bit/5.6MHz > 16-bit/44.1kHz) > cdwav (edits)
source: Nakamichi CM-300 shotgun (CP-4) x2 > Cassette Master (Marantz Superscope CD320/Maxell UDXLII C-90)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy performance with standout versions of Minglewood, Cassidy, Loser and The Other One; audience recording is decent but needs pitch correction
ai_review.review: The show shines with a furnace‑blasting first set (Minglewood Blues, Cassidy, Loser) and a second‑set highlight reel featuring Samson & Delilah, a unique I Need a Miracle jam and a storm‑day The Other One. The audience‑sourced tape is listenable and often praised as the nicest for this run, yet it suffers from noticeable speed/pitch inconsistencies and occasional missing drum cues that require correction.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (high energy, several standout songs) outweighs the technical flaws of the audience recording, which needs pitch/speed fixes.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Needs pitch‑correction across the set (various -2% to +0.5% adjustments), swimmy sound on headphones, occasional missing drums into Space and some audience chatter; second set has clearer image than first.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets are praised as the best of the three‑night run, with tight transitions and a memorable jam sequence leading from I Need a Miracle into The Other One.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals are described as front‑and‑center; his guitar work drives the Loser duet with Phil and launches an inventive G‑jam during I Need a Miracle.
band_member_comments.Phil: Provides his characteristic rumble that cues The Other One, adding to the powerful second‑set momentum.
band_member_comments.Bob: Locks in tightly on Loser, briefly mirrors the Crazy Fingers riff, and underpins the heavy Samson & Delilah performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: Generally solid but with noted missing drum fills into Space on some source mixes; overall rhythm feels strong despite occasional edits.
